reviewer: Single assistant still-image assessment; no human-panel consensus
method: Ten preselected pairs, original lenses retained alongside explicitly labelled GBA views. Native backbuffers only; staged art images are not reachable-route evidence. No animation-feel or hardware-port claim.

rows.gloom_improvement: The cheerful fronts read as constructed parade scenery, with bright walking edges and a compact pixel HUD.
rows.remaining_wl4_advantage: WL4 has stronger organic texture, depth separation and character posing.
rows.next_art_work: Author varied cardboard fronts and backstage construction details.

rows.gloom_improvement: The line, hanging body and material edge share a clear native pixel grid.
rows.remaining_wl4_advantage: Our moving structures remain thin and repetitive beside the reference pistons.
rows.next_art_work: Author the actual pulley housings, counterweight cars and hanging fabric.

rows.gloom_improvement: The canopy, chapel, wooden surfaces, fruit and Wax volume are more coherent.
rows.remaining_wl4_advantage: Our terrain still reads as beams and a large lever label competes with the fruit.
rows.next_art_work: Replace generic supports visually with branches, fruit cages and roots; preserve the true contact edges.

rows.gloom_improvement: The wider Mirror view retains both bodies and a consistent material scale.
rows.remaining_wl4_advantage: WL4 has more tangible doors, streets and light; ours is still detached ledges.
rows.next_art_work: Make each collision domain read as actual apartment rooms, shutters and furniture.

rows.gloom_improvement: The slanted city composition and Censer field radius are visible.
rows.remaining_wl4_advantage: The retained warning-phase frame is sparse; it does not explain its ecology as clearly as the lava reference.
rows.next_art_work: Author warning, falling and kneeling poses, and judge their whole actual motion sequence.

rows.gloom_improvement: A distinct rib-vault and rose-window interior replaces the shared open skyline.
rows.remaining_wl4_advantage: The new ribs are still repetitive linework; WL4 gives fewer objects more material depth.
rows.next_art_work: Distinguish chained moving modules from attached masonry and weight-bearing joints.

rows.gloom_improvement: Ivory masonry, warm windows and violet recesses replace a grey wash; polarity is readable.
rows.remaining_wl4_advantage: Our thin halo is less immediately interpretable than the reference traversal object.
rows.next_art_work: Differentiate anchored/free metal, mounting hardware and reciprocal-force motion cues.

rows.remaining_wl4_advantage: Words remain labelled slabs instead of convincing physical typography.
rows.next_art_work: Author actual word and punctuation silhouettes with clear collision surfaces.

rows.next_art_work: Author structural apparatus and crowd compression/impact/release poses; do not merely enlarge the portrait.

rows.next_art_work: Use actual three-act action frames to refine anticipation, posing and specific arena props.
